sources.entry: Chhoto URL - Simple, lightning-fast URL shortener with no bloat (fork of simply-shorten). (Demo, Source Code, Clients) MIT Rust/Docker

summary.one_liner: Chhoto URL is a simple, self-hosted URL shortener written in Rust, with optional custom slugs, expiry, hit counting, and no extra features.
summary.what_it_does: Shortens long URLs to randomly generated links, or to custom short names if enabled, and can set links to expire after a chosen time. Opening a short link redirects straight to the long URL without an intermediate page. It records hit counts per link without storing other visitor data. Links can be edited, temporarily disabled, annotated with notes, and filtered in the UI, and QR codes can be generated. It supports OIDC authentication, API key and hashed password login, and a JSON-RPC-like API. A public mode lets anyone add links, with admin password needed for deletion and listing, and the frontend can be disabled.
use_cases: create short links for my website
share short links with QR codes
track click counts on short links without analytics
run a public link shortener with admin control
how_to_run: Run the Docker container using the provided compose file (see README links for Docker Hub and Codeberg)
notable: Custom short link names are optional, not just randomly generated slugs
Hit counting records only the hit, with no other tracking
Public mode allows anonymous link creation while keeping admin-only deletion
Uses a scratch-based Docker image and a compose file
caveats: Basic password authentication is not encrypted in transport, so a reverse proxy with SSL is recommended
The public demo database is cleared every 15 minutes, so it is only for testing
Generating new links can start failing after a few thousand links unless slug style and length are tuned
